tei:div.tei:p: ༁ྃ: bde chen zhing sgrub kyi bka' srung gsol mchod bkrigs chags su bris pa bzhugs so:

gu ru rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo// zangs lcags snod du gtor ma ni// zur gsum mtho gang tsam gcig laḥ mdun du zur gsum 'khyud gang bcasaḥ g.yas g.yon sor bzhi tsam pa gnyisaḥ dkar dmar rgyan dang ldan pa bshams: hūm̐ snang ba mtha' yas bka' srung ba: bdud pho nag po seng ge'i gdong : nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: ber gsol g.yas pas phyar dar la: g.yon pas dmar gtor dgra la 'phen: chibs su rta nag rkang gsum chibs: yum ni dmar mo seng gdong ma: kha ṭwāṃ tsitta phyag na 'dzin: rta dmar chibs pa'i g.yas g.yon du: bam ro pho mo dang bcas gsal: hūm̐ 'og min dur khrod chen po dang : rtsub 'gyur tshal dang bsil ba'i tshal: dur khrod brgyad dang nyer bzhi'i gnas: gtsug lag chos 'khor bzhugs gnas nas: zhing skyong 'khor bcas spyan 'dren no: gtso 'khor 'tshams pa'i gdan la bzhugs: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin dang : rang rang mthun pa'i rdzas kyis bskang : sman raka gtor ma 'bul gyis bzhes: oṃ singha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭaḥ oṃ si na ra ma hūṃ phaṭaḥ tri hring dza hūm̐ phaṭaḥ tri hring dza rbad rbadaḥ bha ling ta khā hi khā hiḥ hūm̐ sngon tshe rgyal ba'i spyan snga ru: khas blangs sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrungs: mthu stobs nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam: zhing skyong 'khor bcas bdag gis bstod: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma bzhes: 'phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub pa dang : gang bcol las rnams 'grub par mdzod: zhing skyong thugs kar zla ba'i steng : hūm̐ mthar yab sngags g.yas su 'khor: yum gyi thugs kar nyi ma'i steng : bhyo mthar yum sngags g.yon du 'khor: baṃ ro pho mo'i snying gar tri: de mthar rang sngags g.yas g.yon 'khor: de gnyis yig mgo thur bstan no: bdag gi zhal nas bka' bsgo'i tshul: yab sngags 'bru bdun bzlas pa yis: yab yum sngon gyi dam tshig dran: rnal 'byor khyed cag 'khor bcas kyi: bar chad thams cad sel ba dang : chos mthun bsam pa bdag gis sgrub:

nam zhig dus la 'pho ba'i tshe: bde ba can gyi zhing khams su: sngon nas bsu zhing rgyab nas skyel: zhes gsungs khas blangs dam bcas bsgom: yab sngags phreng bskor ya zung bsnyen: de nas gtor 'bul byed 'dod na: dmar gtor chung ngu gcig bran la: na mo dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum: bde chen zhing du bzhugs pa yi: lha tshogs kun gyi bden pa dang : zhing skyong yab yum mthu stobs kyis: bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi: tshe srog bsod nams la gnod cing : phyi ma bde chen zhing khams su: 'gro la bar du gcod byed pa'i: dgra bgegs bdud dang 'byung po'i tshogs: dmar chen gtor ma 'di nyid la: khug cig dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho phaṭa: zhing skyong yab yum 'khor bcas kyi: zhal du bstab bo khā raṃ khā hi: hūm̐ dpal ldan zhing skyong sku mdog nag: dbu ni seng ge'i dbu can la: phyag g.yas ru mtshon dgra la 'debs: g.yon pas bhandha dgra snying 'dzin: ber chen nag po sku la gsol: bdud rta nag po'i steng na bzhugs: de yi g.yas su bam ro pho: sku mdog nag po spre'u mgo: lag pa bya sder sar brdzis pas: ri rab ldig ldig 'byung bar nus: rkang pa spre'u'i rkang pa de: nam mkhar bkyags pas lha rnams sngangs: rkang pa'i steng du dmar gtor khyer: dgra la 'phangs pas bdun rgyud gcod: zhal nas me lce 'bar ba yis: dgra bo'i mi mkhar 'ur gyis bsregs: seng gdong g.yon du dza ka dzaḥ sku mdog dmar mo me yi mdog: g.yas pas ru mtshon 'tshub pa yis: snang srid thams cad dbang du sdud: g.yon pas tsitta 'dzin pa yis: dgra rgyud gtan nas brlags par nus: de yi g.yon du bam ro mo: sku mdog de ni dmar mo la: mgo ni spre'u gdong can no: lag pa bya sder sar brdzis pas: ri rab ldig ldig 'byung bar nus: rkang pa spre'u'i rkang pa de: nam mkhar bkyags pas lha rnams sngangs: rkang pa'i steng du dmar gtor khyer: dgra la 'phangs pas bdun rgyud gcod:

zhal nas me lce 'bar ba yis: dgra yi mi mkhar 'ur 'ur bsregs: seng gdong yab yum 'khor dang bcas: 'dir gshegs brgyan pa'i gtor ma bzhes: sgrub pa'i bar chad thams cad sol: dgra jag chom rkun 'tshe ba zlog: dam sri bgegs kyi gnod pa zlog: pha rol byad dang rbod gtong zlog: yams nad rims nad dal kha zlog: bcol ba'i phrin las bsgrub par mdzod: gong gi sngags ring yongs rdzogs ni: bdun nam nyer gcig brjod la phul: gtso 'khor bzhi po skad cig la: stong gsum srid gsum lan gsum bskor: gnod byed thams cad tshar bcad nas: rang gi sgrub khang de nyid la: lan gsum bskor ba byas nas kyang : rang gi rgyab kyi phyogs bzhugs nas: sgrub pa'i rgyab brten byed par bsgom: bde chen zhing sgrub bka' bsrung 'di: sgrub pa'i cha lag tshang ba'i phyir: dge slong rā ga a sye yis: bya lo lo gsar tshes gcig gi: phyi dro'i cha la bsgrigs pa ste: yig mkhan dge slong sbyin pas byas: nyes 'gal chos skyong nyid la bshags: dge bas gnam chos bstan pa ni: gaṅgā'i rgyun bzhin 'phel rgyas shog: sarba maṅga laṃ/// /
